therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: dopaminergic pathway modulation reducing sensorimotor symptoms
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Mean change from baseline in IRLS Rating Scale total score at Week 12 and Week 26; Number of participants with clinically meaningful augmentation and early morning rebound

results.effect_size: IRLS LS mean difference: -2.1 points at Week 12 (ropinirole -14.2 vs placebo -12.1); -2.5 points at Week 26 (ropinirole -15.9 vs placebo -13.4)
subgroup_findings: At Week 67 (open-label), mean change from baseline in IRLS was -20.4 points
184 participants rated much/very much improved on CGI-I at Week 67
Confirmed augmentation: 7 in DB ropinirole arm, 8 in OL ropinirole arm, 1 in placebo arm
Clinically meaningful augmentation: 5 in DB ropinirole, 5 in OL ropinirole, 1 in placebo
Confirmed EMR: 4 in DB ropinirole, 2 in OL ropinirole, 1 in placebo
Sleep disturbance improvement at Week 12: ropinirole -24.0 vs placebo -15.0
Sleep adequacy improvement at Week 26: ropinirole +26.0 vs placebo +14.9
safety_signals: Serious adverse events were infrequent and distributed across both arms
B-cell lymphoma and uterine cancer reported as SAEs in ropinirole arm
Overall augmentation and EMR rates were low across both arms

context.duration: 15 months total (26-week double-blind phase + 40-week open-label phase)
